self-rise.reading: Status configuration checks eligibility before the general effect; damage configuration uses its additional-effect path. Multiple requests keep stored order, query each component, skip blocked components, and suppress the shared animation after the first successful component. Stage feedback uses actual change, not requested change; no rollback of earlier changes.

self-drop-after-damage.reading: Reached while dealing damage; target side being entirely unable stops these requests. Each component is separately queried and submitted in stored order; first successful component controls shared animation. This is neither an immediate unconditional self-drop nor an HP loss.

target-drop.reading: Reflectable status configuration checks target stage eligibility before ordinary submission; damage additional effect rejects substitute absorption, then queries before submission. These ordinary single-target requests do not acquire the separate multi-stat Mirror Armor precheck.

central_boundary: StatStages 9-113 and 123-355: qualification, Contrary before Simple, limits, Mirror Armor reflection, actual-change flags and reactions. Request quantity does not certify eventual state.
protected_exclusions: Two ordinary multi-target Mirror Armor parameter definitions remain in their dedicated group; K01-K22, direct stage rewrites and HP sharing are distinct. No finished formal replacement is proposed.
